22.cite: The Daily Star (2025). Bangladesh's Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025: key takeaways.
22.title: Bangladesh's Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025: key takeaways
22.note: Read. Cabinet approved the draft on 9 Oct 2025 and it awaited gazette at the time of writing. Covers consent, purpose limitation, breach notification, cross-border transfer, the National Data Governance Authority, sensitive data, penalties. Land and deed records are not listed by name. Search headlines later report the gazette, which we did not open: check the current legal status with a lawyer.

23.cite: The Business Standard (2023). EC to monitor partner organisations to protect NID data.
23.title: EC to monitor partner organisations to protect NID data
23.note: Read. On 13 July 2023 the Election Commission put 171 partner organisations under round-the-clock surveillance, required an ICT Division security certificate to be eligible for an NID data agreement, and planned audits every three to six months.
